source_grader_review.scope: Static review of numeric alignment, label/interval metrics and score combination; source benchmark not executed.
findings: Numeric and categorical agreement use shared row identities; numeric agreement also uses shared value columns. Enforce completeness separately.
Duplicate keys retain the first row. Fresh contracts should reject duplicate identifiers.
Numeric coercion and missing-value masks can omit pairs; explicit missing/nonfinite-value contracts are required.
Interval overlap rules may allow many-to-many matches; require an explicit geometric and multiplicity policy.
Artifact checks are multiplied. Which checks are configured per task has not been audited because ground-truth packages were not downloaded.
